description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Physical Blink 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Primordial], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Heaven and Earth Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Primordial
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Earth abilities

description.name: Heaven and Earth Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Heaven and Earth after using three Earth abilities
